verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe reading issues, writing code, running tests, and opening PRs (docs-16, docs-3, docs-1, docs-15), and Slack integration can turn a bug report into a PR (docs-11). However, community reports describe frequent failures, unreliable self-verification, and degraded output quality that would undermine fully autonomous issue-to-PR completion without human review (comm-16, comm-17, comm-19, comm-20).
